briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 hits 94% on GPQA while xAI scales Colossus to 1M H100s

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-modal reasoning models amid intensifying US-China competition. Compute shortages persist despite massive buildouts. DialectForge protocol gains traction in securing multi-agent systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with native agentic workflows. Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Opus. Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4 enter evaluation. xAI Colossus cluster powers Grok-3 training run.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft and Google announce new 500MW data center campuses in Texas and Arizona. Power grid constraints slow European AI expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect negotiation become the default security layer before 2028?
